title: Auth0 Identity Provider Migration
blockers: Functional Auth0 Preview smoke requires OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET to be configured directly in Vercel; the secret must not be sent through chat or committed.

notes: Replaces Neon-specific web authentication with Auth0 through the existing provider-neutral OIDC boundary required by DEC-001.
Kairo remains authoritative for Workspace/Brand membership, authorization and audit; identity-provider claims do not become tenant authorization truth.
Auth0 Universal Login owns email/password credentials and Google social authentication; Kairo does not collect passwords.
No database schema or user migration is introduced. Existing Neon Postgres remains the application datastore.
Release, production environment switching, deployment and production enablement remain separate exact-SHA gates.

approvals.rationale: After the explicitly proposed next slice 'VS-16 — Identity Provider Migration: Neon Auth → Auth0' was waiting only for VS-15 merge, Sazid Khan confirmed VS-15 was merged and instructed 'complete it'. This authorizes the bounded FR-01 Auth0 provider migration described immediately before that instruction.

DEC-001 already approves a managed standards-based OIDC/OAuth provider behind a Kairo-owned provider-neutral identity/session adapter. Auth0 is a provider replacement within that approved boundary; Workspace/Brand authorization policy is unchanged.

The instruction to complete the previously proposed VS-16 authorizes runtime implementation outside production. Work is restricted to the approved identity adapter/web auth flow and deterministic verification.
Exact-SHA human certification is required after deterministic gates and functional Auth0 Preview evidence pass.
Implementation approval does not authorize release or environment switching.
Production enablement and production deployment remain separate explicit gates.

evidence: Implementation runtime head 43c2bf6c269adf2db60094c6dfd9a92e9e31f165: CI #431 PASS after governance correction; runtime verification includes workspace typecheck, tests and builds.
Functional Auth0 Preview smoke remains pending environment-secret configuration.
